ov: Over 100 species of semiaquatic salamanders in North America, Europe, North Africa and Asia. They go from water-living larva to a land-living juvenile called an eft, and adults return to water each year to breed.

why.dg: Many newts have toxic skin. The rough-skinned newt of the Pacific Northwest carries enough tetrodotoxin to kill an adult human.
why.h: Over most of its range it hibernates in winter, often with many newts sharing one underground hiding place.

len: Up to 16 cm (great crested newt, females)
rg: North America, Europe, North Africa and Asia.
fx: The Yunnan lake newt is thought to have died out in 1979.
